title: Sign up with email or Algerian phone number
acceptance: A visitor can create an account with email+password or phone (+213[5-7]XXXXXXXX) and must verify it by code before booking

title: Sign in with password or one-time phone code
acceptance: Login works with email+password or phone OTP (6 digits, 10 min, 5 tries); same generic error for every failure

title: Session for both Next.js apps
acceptance: Website and admin hold an httpOnly cookie on the Next.js server; Django session tokens can be revoked server-side; logout revokes the token
code_today: Signed cookie; admin JWT cannot be revoked

title: Password reset and change
acceptance: Reset by email or phone code; change requires current password; all other sessions revoked after change

title: Two-factor login
acceptance: Staff must enrol TOTP or passkey before first use; hosts must enrol before editing payout details

title: Profile management
acceptance: User edits name (Arabic and Latin), avatar, language, phone; changing phone or email requires re-verification

title: Login rate limiting shared across servers
acceptance: 5 failures in 15 min lock 60 s per account and per IP, stored in Redis

title: One user, many roles
acceptance: One user may be a guest, an individual host and a member of several organisations at once

title: Favourites
acceptance: Guest adds or removes a listing or trip from favourites; list endpoint paginated

title: Create an organisation (agency, hotel, hostel)
acceptance: Creating an organisation makes the creator its owner; status starts pending_verification

title: Active-organisation switcher
acceptance: A user with several memberships picks the active one; every host request carries it and is checked
code_today: Built in website 2026-11-04 (host menu, membership checked server-side)

title: Invite a team member
acceptance: Invite by email or phone with a role; invite token expires in 7 days; invitee accepts after signing in

title: Change role, remove member, transfer ownership
acceptance: Only owner transfers ownership; an organisation always has exactly one owner; audited

title: Per-role permissions inside an organisation
acceptance: Permissions per role (owner, admin, manager, agent, guide) incl. bookings.respond for owner/admin/manager only
code_today: Any member can do anything operational

title: Re-verification on legal field change
acceptance: Changing legal name, RC, NIF or licence number moves verification back to pending and notifies staff

title: Public organisation profile
acceptance: Public page shows name, logo, verified badge, listings, trips, rating; never legal numbers or staff phones

title: Guided onboarding per host type
acceptance: Individual 12 steps, agency 5, hotel 7, hostel 7, all served from the published config; every flow asks the booking approval mode

title: Save onboarding drafts on the server
acceptance: Draft saved per user and host type with the config version it started from; resumable on any device

title: Upload verification documents
acceptance: Required document list depends on host type; files go to a private bucket; each document has its own review status

title: Host verification lifecycle
acceptance: Statuses applied, under_review, approved, changes_requested, rejected, suspended, banned; moves only along the allowed transitions with reasons
code_today: Admin only, not linked to website

title: Payout or refund account details
acceptance: Host stores CCP (RIP) or bank RIB in own name; changing it needs 2FA and holds payouts 72 h

title: Connect a hotel's own system
acceptance: A hotel or hostel connects its channel manager, PMS, iCal feed or CSV file; room types, availability, prices and services (restaurants, spa, parking) are imported and kept in sync; manual entry stays possible

title: What each host type may publish
acceptance: Individual: homes and vehicles; agency: experiences and trips; hotel and hostel: their property with room types; enforced by API and database, create-listing flow offers only allowed choices

title: Default approval mode per host or organisation
acceptance: Owner default applies to new listings; a listing may override; platform switch can force request mode

title: Create and edit a listing (home, hotel, hostel, experience, vehicle)
acceptance: Host creates a draft, fills vertical-specific fields, submits; server validates every field

title: Listing review before publication
acceptance: Submitted listing goes to pending_review; published only after staff approval; edits of key fields go back to review

title: Listing status lifecycle
acceptance: Statuses draft, pending_review, changes_requested, published, paused, rejected, suspended, archived, deleted (soft); allowed moves enforced

title: Room types for hotels and hostels
acceptance: A property has room types with price, capacity, unit (room or bed), inventory count, amenities, photos

title: Amenities and categories from a shared list
acceptance: Amenities and property types are reference rows with en/fr/ar names; listings link to them

title: Location: wilaya, commune, exact and public point
acceptance: Listing references a commune; exact point hidden until booking confirmed; public point fuzzed by about 500 m
code_today: Free text city, exact coordinates public

title: House rules, stay rules and cancellation policy
acceptance: Min/max nights, check-in/out times, rules list, policy chosen from templates

title: Pause and soft delete
acceptance: Host can pause or delete; delete is soft and keeps bookings; staff can restore

title: Featured listings
acceptance: Staff feature a published listing with optional start and end dates and position

title: Vehicle listing specifics
acceptance: Make, model, year, seats, gearbox, fuel, pickup points, driver age and licence rules

title: Canonical experience types
acceptance: Every experience has one of 8 types (excursion, guided tour, nature and adventure, desert, sport, workshops and culture, gastronomy, wellness); search filters, cards, creation forms and admin use the same list

title: Experience listing specifics
acceptance: Duration, languages, meeting point, time slots with seats

title: Agency-only trips
acceptance: Only verified agencies create trips; hotels and hostels never see the option

title: Trip itinerary and inclusions
acceptance: Day-by-day itinerary, inclusions, exclusions, meeting point, group limits, cancellation policy step

title: Departures with seats and price
acceptance: Each departure has dates, seats total, price per person, minimum group, status (scheduled, guaranteed, cancelled, completed)

title: Trips go through review
acceptance: Same review flow as listings

title: Search trips by date
acceptance: Trip search filters departures overlapping the searched dates

title: Canonical trip types
acceptance: Every trip has one of 8 types (group tour, private trip, adventure, Saharan expedition, cultural, hiking, relaxation, religious); used by trip creation, search filters, cards and admin

title: Cancel a departure under minimum group
acceptance: Agency cancels a departure; all its bookings are cancelled with full refund and notifications

title: No double booking for single units
acceptance: Database refuses two active bookings on the same unit with overlapping half-open ranges, even under concurrent requests

title: Pooled inventory for rooms, beds, seats
acceptance: Per day or slot: held + booked never exceeds total, enforced by a database check

title: Host calendar: block days and set prices
acceptance: Block or unblock days and set per-day price, per listing or per room type

title: Availability window and partial matches
acceptance: Search shows listings overlapping the dates with a 'available X to Y' hint; booking only inside free nights

title: Temporary holds during payment
acceptance: A hold blocks inventory for 15 min while a guest pays; expires automatically

title: External calendar sync (iCal)
acceptance: Import and export iCal feeds with SSRF protection

title: Server-side price quote
acceptance: Quote lists nights x per-day price, cleaning fee, taxes, discounts, total; has an ID and expires in 30 min

title: No guest service fee
acceptance: Guests never pay a BLADUS fee; quote shows 'No BLADUS fees'

title: Length-of-stay discounts
acceptance: Weekly and monthly discount percentages applied in the quote

title: Tourist tax and VAT lines
acceptance: Quote shows taxe de séjour by star rating and VAT where applicable; rates from settings

title: Whole dinars to guests, centimes inside
acceptance: Prices shown in whole DZD; stored in centimes; rounding rule documented and tested

title: Instant booking
acceptance: Instant mode: booking confirmed once the commission deposit check passes (model M1)

title: Request to book
acceptance: Request mode creates pending; host accepts or declines within 24 h (setting)

title: Automatic expiry of requests
acceptance: A scheduled job expires pending requests at the deadline and notifies both sides

title: Automatic completion after check-out
acceptance: Job marks confirmed bookings completed after check-out; opens the review window

title: Unified booking state machine
acceptance: Statuses: pending, confirmed, declined, expired, cancelled, completed, disputed; payment status is separate

title: Booking snapshot
acceptance: At confirmation store price lines, commission rate and amount, cancellation policy, listing title and address

title: Guest and host booking lists
acceptance: Paginated lists filtered by status and dates; host list scoped to active organisation

title: Booking reference
acceptance: Human reference BLD-YYYY-XXXXXX unique, shown everywhere

title: Trip departure booking
acceptance: Books seats on a departure; per-person price; respects agency approval mode

title: Idempotent booking creation
acceptance: POST with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same booking

title: Disputes
acceptance: Either party opens a dispute within 14 days after check-out with statement and files; support resolves

title: Guest cancellation by policy
acceptance: Refund percentage computed from the snapshot policy and time before check-in

title: Host cancellation
acceptance: Host cancels with reason; guest gets full refund of anything paid; host commission returned; host cancellation counted

title: Staff cancellation and refund
acceptance: Staff cancel or refund with reason; partial refunds add up and never exceed amount paid

title: Commission reversal rules
acceptance: Decline and host cancel: full reversal; guest cancel: commission on the non-refunded part kept

title: Double-entry ledger
acceptance: Every money movement is a transaction whose entries sum to zero; entries never updated or deleted

title: Prepaid commission wallet (model M1)
acceptance: Each host account (user or organisation) has a commission wallet; balance derived from the ledger

title: Commission deduction on confirmation
acceptance: On confirm: commission = rate x accommodation subtotal (excl. cleaning, taxes), posted once per booking

title: Commission rate resolution
acceptance: Host override if set, else host-type default from settings; rate snapshot on booking

title: Manual wallet top-up by staff
acceptance: Amount 1 to 10,000,000 DZD, method, receipt reference unique per method, optional four-eyes above a threshold

title: Online wallet top-up via gateway
acceptance: Host tops up with CIB/Edahabia through Chargily; credited only after a verified webhook

title: Negative balance handling
acceptance: Negative balance shows host banner, admin flag and dashboard item; below a threshold new instant bookings switch to request

title: Wallet history for hosts
acceptance: Host sees balance and paginated entries with booking links

title: Gateway webhooks
acceptance: Webhook payloads stored raw, signature verified, deduplicated by event id, processed once

title: Payouts and guest payments (model M4)
acceptance: Schema supports guest payments, escrow and host payouts; disabled until legal approval

title: Commission invoices to hosts
acceptance: Monthly invoice per host with sequential number, NIF/NIS of both sides, HT, VAT, TTC; PDF kept 10 years

title: Money as centimes with currency
acceptance: All amounts BIGINT centimes + currency code DZD

title: Write a review after a stay
acceptance: Only for a completed booking, within 14 days, one per booking; 5 sub-ratings + comment

title: Host reviews guest
acceptance: Host reviews guest under the same window; double-blind reveal

title: Host reply
acceptance: One public reply per review, editable for 48 h

title: Report and moderate reviews
acceptance: Anyone reports with a reason; moderator hides, restores or deletes with reason; allowed moves enforced

title: Ratings derived from reviews
acceptance: Listing, host and organisation ratings and counts recomputed from published reviews

title: Conversations between guest and host
acceptance: Thread per listing inquiry or booking; org members with access see org threads

title: Incremental sync
acceptance: Endpoint returns messages changed since a cursor; clients poll every 5 to 15 s while open

title: Read state and unread counts
acceptance: Per participant last-read pointer; unread counts per thread and total

title: Contact detail masking before confirmation
acceptance: Phone numbers, emails, RIP/CCP numbers and WhatsApp links masked until a booking is confirmed

title: Attachments
acceptance: Images and PDFs up to 10 MB, scanned

title: Staff messages and broadcast
acceptance: Staff message a user or segment with permission and audit

title: In-app notifications
acceptance: Events (request, accept, decline, expiry, cancel, review, verification) create notifications; mark read, read all

title: Email and SMS notifications
acceptance: Critical events also by email or SMS in the user's language; provider behind an interface

title: Notification preferences
acceptance: User opts in or out per channel for non-critical events; marketing needs explicit opt-in

title: Outbox pattern
acceptance: Events written in the same transaction as the change, then sent by workers with retries

title: Search with filters and facets
acceptance: Filters: vertical, wilaya, commune, dates, guests, price, property type, amenities, rating, instant; facet counts returned

title: Map search
acceptance: Bounding box filter and up to 500 pins; public points only

title: Text search in three languages
acceptance: Title and place search tolerant to accents and transliteration (trigram)

title: 69 wilayas and 1,541 communes
acceptance: Reference tables seeded from el-amin (CC0) + ihahachi (MIT) with source and valid_from

title: Sorting and pagination
acceptance: Sort by relevance, price, rating, newest; cursor or page pagination capped at 50

title: Hotels as their own vertical
acceptance: Vertical filter includes hotel; analytics roll hotel into the home family

title: Photo upload with direct-to-storage
acceptance: Presigned upload to quarantine, validation, re-encode, EXIF stripped, renditions, perceptual hash

title: Private documents
acceptance: KYC files in a private bucket, virus scanned, short-lived signed URLs, every view logged

title: Photo ordering and cover
acceptance: Host orders photos and picks a cover; minimum 5 photos for homes

title: Moderation queues with waiting time
acceptance: Queues for hosts, listings, trips, documents, reviews, disputes with count, oldest submitted_at, priority

title: Change requests to hosts
acceptance: Moderator sends checklist items and a note; host sees them and resubmits

title: Reason catalogue
acceptance: Preset reasons per action with localized host-facing text; free note allowed

title: Bulk actions with per-item results
acceptance: Bulk approve returns success or error per item; one audit entry per item

title: Undo window
acceptance: Approve and hide can be reversed within 8 s via the inverse transition, audited

title: Cascade on host suspension
acceptance: Suspending or banning a host pauses its listings and trips; future bookings flagged for support

title: Risk flags
acceptance: Rules flag new account + high value, duplicate photos, contact info in messages; flags create review cases

title: Document-level review
acceptance: Approve or reject each document separately; host approval requires all required documents approved

title: Staff roles and permissions in the database
acceptance: One staff role (admin) with every permission, stored and enforced by the API, deny by default (DEC-016)

title: Staff invitation and activation
acceptance: Invite sends a one-time link; staff sets password and MFA; deactivation revokes sessions immediately

title: Append-only audit log
acceptance: Every staff mutation, every host money or team action, logins and KYC views logged with actor id, IP, before/after; no update or delete

title: Actors by id, not name
acceptance: Ledger, payouts, disputes, config publishes reference staff user ids

title: Separate admin API surface
acceptance: /api/v1/admin/* only for staff tokens; never reachable with a guest or host session

title: Audited CSV exports
acceptance: Exports cover full filtered set, formula-injection safe, audited with filters and row count; large exports run as jobs

title: Platform settings
acceptance: One settings record: commission defaults, request TTL, instant-book switch, maintenance mode, session timeout, locales

title: Versioned onboarding config
acceptance: Draft and published versions per host type; publish creates an immutable version; rollback = republish older

title: Onboarding field editor
acceptance: Add, edit, reorder fields with canonical types; core steps and fields cannot be removed

title: Serve published config to the website
acceptance: GET returns the published flow; answers to custom fields stored as JSON and validated against that version

title: Taxonomy management
acceptance: Categories, amenities, property types with en/fr/ar, order, active flag; soft delete only when unused

title: Coupons
acceptance: Code, type, value, dates, usage limits, scope; redemption at quote time with per-user limit

title: Who pays the discount
acceptance: A coupon is funded by BLADUS (reduces commission) or by the host; recorded in the ledger

title: KPIs by period, host type, vertical, wilaya
acceptance: Bookings, gross booking value, commission, active listings, hosts; period over period from real dates

title: Host-type by vertical cross-tab
acceptance: Impossible cells shown as not applicable, not zero

title: Host earnings dashboard
acceptance: Earnings recognised at completion; shows upcoming, completed, commission paid

title: Consent records
acceptance: Terms version, privacy notice version, marketing opt-in stored with timestamp

title: Data subject requests
acceptance: Access export (JSON), correction, deletion by anonymisation keeping legal records; tracked with deadlines

title: Data residency
acceptance: Personal data and backups stored in Algeria unless an ANPDP authorisation exists

title: Retention schedule
acceptance: Jobs delete or redact KYC images after the retention window; accounting records kept 10 years

title: Breach response
acceptance: Runbook with a 5-day ANPDP notification clock and incident register

title: Foreign guest declaration support
acceptance: Guest nationality and ID type captured when required; host reminded of the declaration duty

title: API response time
acceptance: p95 under 300 ms for reads and 600 ms for booking create at 50 requests/s on one app node

title: Search response time
acceptance: p95 under 500 ms with 20,000 listings and dates

title: Availability
acceptance: 99.5% monthly for the public API; planned maintenance announced

title: Backups and restore
acceptance: Point-in-time recovery 7 days, nightly encrypted dump in a second Algerian location, monthly restore drill; RPO 15 min, RTO 4 h

title: Security baseline
acceptance: OWASP API Top 10 controls, TLS everywhere, secrets outside code, dependency scanning in CI

title: Three languages and right-to-left
acceptance: Every API error and notification has en/fr/ar text; Latin digits in Arabic

title: Time and dates
acceptance: Timestamps stored in UTC; business dates in Africa/Algiers; week starts Sunday; weekend Friday-Saturday

title: API contract
acceptance: OpenAPI generated in CI; typed client shared by both apps; breaking changes need a new version

title: Observability
acceptance: JSON logs with request, user and org ids; error tracking; metrics and health checks

title: Test coverage
acceptance: Services 90% line coverage; property tests for money and dates; concurrency tests on real PostgreSQL

title: Rate limits
acceptance: Per user and per IP throttles per endpoint group; SMS budget alarms

title: Unique identifiers
acceptance: UUIDv7 primary keys plus human references; no time or random based ids

title: Accessibility of messages
acceptance: Errors have stable codes the apps map to localized text
